# The key-import layout follow-up keeps minimum values while using logical dimensions

The follow-up replaces min-width:600px and min-height:400px with min-inline-size:600px and min-block-size:400px in the dialog root. The values remain unchanged; this is separate from the preceding dialog rebuild. The accepted stylesheet retains these declarations. No computed layout, writing-mode or screen-size test was run.

Scope: OpenPGP import-info CSS follow-up.
